steps.note: Open a new event creation screen for the buyer-side currency setup.

args.goal: On the new event screen, open the Edit Currencies option, select Multi Currency, tick each currency requested by the case, enter the defined conversion factor beside each selected currency, click OK, reopen Edit Currencies, and stop with Multi Currency, the selected currencies, and their conversion factors visibly shown.

steps.note: No catalog step can operate the currency editor or persist and reopen its currency settings, so perform and verify the complete buyer-side flow on screen.
Assert that the reopened currency configuration visibly remains in Multi Currency mode.
